entity.description:
Nordinbad as it appears in War in the North ]]

Nordinbad is a location in the game The Lord of the Rings: War in the North. It is a Dwarven fortress hidden deep within the Grey Mountains, providing isolation and refuge for the Dwarves of Durin's Folk who have inhabited it since before the Dwarves fled the Grey Mountains. They lived around an underground lake known as Azan-zâram.

Gorin of the Longbeards was the Lord of Nordinbad.

Centuries before the War of the Ring, the great-great grandsire of Lord Gorin, discovered the caves in which dwelt the hidden lake that would be called Azan-zâram. He chose to lead some of his kin there and over the course of many years, they slowly built the hall that they would name, Nordinbad. Though Nordinbad was never wealthy in gold or jewels, the inhabitants considered it to be rich in beauty. So they took great care to enhance and preserve this beauty and to never defile it.
